_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "billing_interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" REAL NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "visible" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("visible" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "billing_orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "discount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "metadata" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_at" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "billing_order_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax" INTEGER NOT NULL, "added_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "billing_subscriptions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "cancel_at_period_end" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("cancel_at_period_end" IN (0, 1)), "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "current_period_end" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current_period_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "billing_subscription_statuses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "subscription_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "billing_entitlements" ("plan_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plan_code", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lock_in_rule_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "apps_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lock_in_attempts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "app_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "app_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_id" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "courses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced', "last_sync_error" TEXT NULL, "institution_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "term_label" TEXT NULL, "academic_year" TEXT NULL, "term_start_date" INTEGER NULL, "term_end_date" INTEGER NULL, "previous_course_id" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cached_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lecturers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "student_course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES courses (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "office" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced', "last_sync_error" TEXT NULL, "student_course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES courses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day_of_week" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "venue" TEXT NULL, "campus" TEXT NULL, "section" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "is_recurring" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_recurring" IN (0, 1)), "specific_date" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cached_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "todo_lists" ("local_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "task_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_pending_deletion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pending_deletion" IN (0, 1)), "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "todo_tag_items" ("local_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_pending_deletion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pending_deletion" IN (0, 1)), "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "todo_items" ("local_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "task_list_local_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES todo_lists (local_id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'needsAction', "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "due" INTEGER NULL, "completed" INTEGER NULL, "subtask_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "position" TEXT NULL, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_pending_deletion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pending_deletion" IN (0, 1)), "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "focused_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "todo_item_tags" ("todo_local_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES todo_items (local_id), "tag_local_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES todo_tag_items (local_id), PRIMARY KEY ("todo_local_id", "tag_local_id"));
